triggers.name: new_or_updated_record
triggers.title: New/updated record
triggers.description: New or updated record in Airtable
triggers.help: Triggers when a new record is created or updated in Airtable. The trigger requires a custom field of type last modified time to be configured to track all editable fields in the selected table within your Airtable instance. If the last modified field is configured to specific fields in the table, th…

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: base_id
input.label: Base
input.hint: Select a base to monitor for new or updated record. Shared bases will also be shown in the picklist.

input.name: table_id
input.label: Table
input.hint: Select a table to monitor for new or updated record.

input.name: view
input.label: View
input.hint: Select a view to monitor for new or updated record.

input.name: modified_time_field
input.label: Last modified time field
input.hint: Select the last modified time field that you prefer. If not provided, the trigger will consider the last modified time field configured for all editable fields.

input.name: since
input.label: When first started, this recipe should pick up events from
input.hint: Get records created or updated since given date/time. Leave empty to get records created or updated one hour ago. Once recipe has been run or tested, value cannot be changed. Learn more
